author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I’m installing Panasonic’s Whisper Remodel LED exhaust fan and using 4-inch insulated ductwork. The warm drive clamp and foil tape keep the ductwork tight against the fan. And it should be exhausted to the exterior of the home using similar methods. Many thanks to Panasonic for sending this fan for my client's project
title: Bathroom Exhaust Fan Ductwork Tips - #shorts #exhaustfan #brandpartner
